items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he was a nice man too, I met George once.

ctx.x: What was distinctive about George Shearing’s style from your perspective?

I liked it because George played octaves and he could duplicate what he wanted to play and he was locking in his chordal concept . . . it was different. I like the way George plays and he was a nice man too, I met George once.
And also blind like Art Tatum. They didn’t see anything they were playing.
